# `spawnables/complex/CSGShape.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/spawnables/complex/CSGShape.js`

============================================================================ CSGShape.js — CSG Boolean operations on mesh entities  Select 2 mesh entities → right-click → CSG Union / Subtract / Intersect V1: Voxelize both → VoxelOps boolean → SDFToMesh marching cubes reconstruct V2: Voxelize both → VoxelOps boolean → DualContouring for sharp features ============================================================================

## Functions

### `async performCSG(editor, entityIdA, entityIdB, operation = 'union', opts = {})`

Perform a CSG boolean operation on two mesh entities.

**Parameters:**

- `editor` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `entityIdA` *(number)* — First mesh entity
- `entityIdB` *(number)* — Second mesh entity
- `operation` *(string)* — 'union' | 'subtract' | 'intersect'
- `opts` *(Object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `opts.resolution` *(number)* — Voxel grid resolution (default 48)
- `opts.deleteOriginals` *(boolean)* — Remove source entities (default false)
- `opts.mode` *(string)* — 'mc' for Marching Cubes V1, 'dc' for Dual Contouring V2 (default 'dc')
- `opts.sharpness` *(number)* — Dual Contouring sharpness 0-1 (default 0.5)

**Returns:** New entity ID or null on failure

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```
